Renovated to retain it's
historical integrity with all the comforts of
home!
CabooseCabins is Not Just a Place to
Stay, It's an Experience!
"Easily
the most interesting place we've ever stayed and possibly the most fun we've had
in a "hotel". -Plymouth, MN
Located
just 1 block from
Sparta's Famous Bike
Trails (click here for bike rental & shuttle info)
Watch Canadian Pacific/SOO, Burlington
Northern/Santa Fe, Union Pacific and
Amtrak
trains pass by while sitting on the deck
Enjoy the nearby Pond,
Artesian Well, La Crosse River, Mowed Hiking Trails, Horseshoe Pit Fire Pit!
Healing Mineral Waters
Sleeps up to
3 adults or 2 adults and 3 children. Plenty of room to pitch a
tent. Inquire about camping for groups.
Microwave, Refrigerator and Gas Grill on Deck
Shower, Toilet,
Air Conditioning, TV/VCR
Interior Photos
An Educational Experience for Children and Adults !
"We
were looking for something different and we found it!" -Appleton, WI
The Erickson family (David, Chelsie, Taylor, Jenny &
Sosa)
"It all started with an idea to turn a caboose into a cabin
near the Sparta bike trails. Most of the other renovated cabooses that
I'd seen looked more like a motel room than a caboose on the inside. We wanted to
keep the interior and exterior of the caboose looking like it did when it was in
service so people could see what a working caboose looked like. Of course
we added all the comforts of home! The
renovations are complete and we invite you and your family to enjoy a stay in one of the
most unique places you will ever experience!"
-David
Erickson, owner
"Wow!
Great Job! ..such a beautiful caboose cabin with all the conveniences one would
need. A night we will remember fondly!" -Arlington, MA
